name: Wolf
source:
"What we're always seeking isn't the blood of others. It's our own death."

Lycoris's childhood friend, bred as an assassin.
He is a bodyguard of Zhang Lei.

[From [url=http://www.rpgdl.org/rsl2/en.html#character]official site[/url]]
